title: PEARL: A Task-Aware Framework for Evaluating Differentially Private Synthetic Educational Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.10612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized learning systems rely on real learner data, including performance, behavior, and demographic information, but these data are highly privacy-sensitive. Differentially private (DP) synthetic data can support system development and educational research while reducing exposure of individual learners. Existing evaluations, however, assess privacy and predictive usefulness separately, without determining whether synthetic learner data remain usable for the intended personalized learning task. We introduce PEARL (Privacy-Equivalence Audit and Release Ledger), which approves a DP synthetic educational dataset only when it passes all required checks of validity, privacy protection, predictive usefulness, and suitability for the intended educational task, while recording why each rejected dataset fails. translated_title: PEARL：一个用于评估差分隐私合成教育数据的任务感知框架
translated_abstract: 个性化学习系统依赖于真实的学习者数据，包括学习表现、行为和人口统计信息，但这些数据具有高度的隐私敏感性。差分隐私（DP）合成数据可以在降低个体学习者信息暴露风险的同时，支持系统开发和教育研究。然而，现有的评估方法将隐私性和预测有用性分开独立评估，没有确定合成学习者数据是否仍然可用于预期的个性化学习任务。我们提出了PEARL（隐私等价审计与发布账本，Privacy-Equivalence Audit and Release Ledger），只有当差分隐私合成教育数据集通过所有必要检查——有效性、隐私保护、预测有用性以及对预期教育任务的适用性——时，才会批准发布该数据集，同时记录每个被拒绝数据集失败的原因。在96个研究设置中（每个设置由数据集、数据生成方法、隐私预算和随机种子定义），仅有12个设置产生了语法
tldr: PEARL是一个任务感知的差分隐私合成教育数据评估框架，只有当合成数据同时通过有效性、隐私保护、预测有用性和预期教育任务适用性四项检查时才批准发布，并记录被拒数据集的失败原因，弥补了现有评估中隐私与任务实用性分离评估的不足。
en_tdlr: PEARL is a task-aware framework that approves differentially private synthetic educational data only when it passes all required checks of validity, privacy protection, predictive usefulness, and suitability for the intended educational task, while recording why rejected datasets fail.
